text:
aya_support: FYI getting multiple customer 503s from hosted us-west-2 since 14:03. Affects AcmeAI and Fathom. ~20% error rate on /v1/generate. Root looks like upstream inference worker crashes. tagging @nate_sre @mike_infra.

nate_sre: On it, can you paste the crash snippet and which pools are affected?

aya_support: Paste of recent runner stderr (one of several similar):
```
[2026-03-17T14:04:12Z] infer-runner[pid=4221]: 2026-03-17 14:04:12.123 ERROR Unhandled exception: std::runtime_error: cuda runtime error (2): out of memory at /app/runtime/gpu_allocator.cpp:214
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::runtime_error'
Aborted (core dumped)
```
Pool: us-west-2-gpu-pool-7. Kube shows container restarted 3x in 5m.

mike_infra: I see a correlated spike in memory usage on node gpu-uw2-110. dmesg shows GPU fault Xid 79 and a process SIGABRT. Kernel log excerpt: 
```
Mar 17 14:03:59 gpu-uw2-110 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus.
Mar 17 14:04:01 kubelet[...]: Container infer-runner crashed with status 134, restarting
```
Also noticing a large number of in-flight large batches from model "gpt-l-opt-2.7b" with seq_len ~2048.

jess_prod: Customer call in 20m. Any quick mitigations we can do to stop the 503 wave? Can we route traffic to fallback model or scale down batch sizing?

nate_sre: Quick mitigation steps rolling now: 1) cordon gpu-uw2-110 and drain affected pods 2) update routing policy to fallback to cpu-small for heavy QPS customers (applied) 3) reduce max_batch_size on us-west-2-gpu-pool to 8 from 32.

deploy-bot: Canary routing change deployed: route heavy sessions -> fallback-cpu-small for orgs: AcmeAI, Fathom.

aya_support: After routing change error rate dropped to ~2% for the last 4 minutes. Customers acknowledging reduced errors.

mike_infra: Root cause hypothesis: the recent runtime change "optimize-prefetch-v2" (commit 7a3b9f2) increased aggressive KV/prefix prefetching which accidentally trips GPU memory growth for long-prefix+large-batch combos. I can repro locally with long prefix (3k tokens) + batch_size 24: memory climbs until allocation fails.

nate_sre: Sounds like a regression. Action items: mike to revert commit 7a3b9f2, add guardrail in runtime to reject batches if projected_use > 90% GPU mem, and add a regression test that simulates long-prefix + batch concurrency. I'll own rollout and verification.

mike_infra: Revert PR opened (#4178), will push hotfix in ~15m. Also adding a short-lived autoscaler throttle to prevent instant large-scale fill while we revert.

jess_prod: Please prepare a short customer-facing note summarizing mitigation and ETA for full fix. Support to send to impacted customers once revert validated.

aya_support: Copy. We'll send interim note now and follow up after full revert verification. Marking SEV3 for tracking.

deploy-bot: Revert PR #4178 merged to main and rolling restart started for us-west-2-gpu-pool-7 (4 pods at a time).

nate_sre: Monitoring: after revert and restarts, error rate is trending down. Keeping pool at reduced batch_size until tomorrow morning while we run synthetic soak tests.

aya_support: Customers confirmed reduced failures, AcmeAI bumped to green on their dashboards. Closing customer escalations for now, will reopen if we see regressions.

mike_infra: Root cause writeup notes: regression in prefetch path -> memory growth under long-prefix + high batch concurrency -> GPU OOM -> runner abort -> k8s restart -> client 503s. Next: add telemetry to detect accelerated mem growth and automated fallback to smaller model/CPU before failing.

nate_sre: I'll create the postmortem template and link commits/metrics. Assigning owners: mike_infra (fix + guardrail), nate_sre (soak/regression tests + rollout), jess_prod & aya_support (customer comms).

jess_prod: Thx team. Please add short customer note to support template repo. :thumbsup:

aya_support: Closing thread, ongoing follow-ups tracked in the PM.
